title: Pathogenome workflow parameters
description: Parameters for downloading accession reads, assembling contigs, predicting genes, and annotating antimicrobial resistance.

accessions.title: Accession IDs
accessions.description: TSV file with a sample-id header and one NCBI or ENA run accession per row.

fondue_email.title: Contact email
fondue_email.description: Email address supplied to q2-fondue for accession downloads.

import_threads.title: Accession import CPUs
import_threads.description: Number of CPUs allocated to the accession import step.

import_memory_gb.title: Accession import memory (GB)
import_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the accession import step, in GB.

import_time_hours.title: Accession import time limit (hours)
import_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the accession import step, in hours.

fondue_threads.title: Fondue threads
fondue_threads.description: Number of download threads and CPUs used by q2-fondue.

fondue_memory_gb.title: Fondue memory (GB)
fondue_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the read download step, in GB.

fondue_time_hours.title: Fondue time limit (hours)
fondue_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the read download step, in hours.

megahit_threads.title: MEGAHIT threads
megahit_threads.description: Number of assembly threads and CPUs used by MEGAHIT.

megahit_memory_gb.title: MEGAHIT memory (GB)
megahit_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the assembly step, in GB.

megahit_time_hours.title: MEGAHIT time limit (hours)
megahit_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the assembly step, in hours.

prodigal_threads.title: Prodigal CPUs
prodigal_threads.description: Number of CPUs allocated to the gene prediction step.

prodigal_memory_gb.title: Prodigal memory (GB)
prodigal_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the gene prediction step, in GB.

prodigal_time_hours.title: Prodigal time limit (hours)
prodigal_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the gene prediction step, in hours.

amr_db_threads.title: AMRFinderPlus database CPUs
amr_db_threads.description: Number of CPUs allocated to the AMRFinderPlus database download step.

amr_db_memory_gb.title: AMRFinderPlus database memory (GB)
amr_db_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the AMRFinderPlus database download step, in GB.

amr_db_time_hours.title: AMRFinderPlus database time limit (hours)
amr_db_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the AMRFinderPlus database download step, in hours.

amr_threads.title: AMR annotation threads
amr_threads.description: Number of threads and CPUs used by AMRFinderPlus annotation.

amr_memory_gb.title: AMR annotation memory (GB)
amr_memory_gb.description: Memory allocated to the AMRFinderPlus annotation step, in GB.

amr_time_hours.title: AMR annotation time limit (hours)
amr_time_hours.description: Maximum runtime for the AMRFinderPlus annotation step, in hours.
